input.answer: I'd go with א, the one tall column. The big "66,513 ₪" on one side and "19,595 ₪" on the other told me straight away the keren is worth joining, and the year-6 version showing "מס במשיכה 0 ₪" and "98,738 ₪" clicked for me. ב shows the same numbers but goes left to right, so I read it backwards.

stuck.why: I start from the right, so I hit '66,513 ₪', then '−13,974 ₪', then '8,487 ₪'. It felt like the money was going down and then up again. Only afterwards did I see it starts at 18,000 on the left.

stuck.where: Option א, top of the keren column
stuck.why: The red striped piece with '−13,974 ₪' worried me for a second. Is the tax taken out of the 66,513 or on top of it? I just went with 66,513 as what's left.
I didn't know the circled 5 could be tapped. Only in the second copy of א, where 6 was circled, did I get that it's the year.

findings.what: The waterfall runs left to right, so reading from the right I get the total first, then a minus, then a plus. Confusing.
A red striped minus of 13,974 ₪ at the top of the column is scary. It's not clear whether it's already taken out of the total.
You don't notice the year in the small bar chart can be changed. The circle on 5 just looks like decoration.
The assumptions paragraph is long and in orange/small text. I didn't read it, so I don't know where 7% or the fees come from.
The fee shows up only as a percent in small grey text, not in shekels.
No next step: nothing tells me what to do to join.
